LESSON MENU
In this lesson you will learn about GATE NETWORKS.INFINITY................
In fact, this small computer chip may contain many gates. State of the art chips may contain hundreds or thousands of gates.
AND, NOT and OR gates are the building blocks of computers.
For example, gate networks allow a computer to add, subtract, multiply, divide and make decisions.
Remember, gates are electronic circuits and computers are made up of hundreds of small electronic circuits.
Gate networks are AND, NOT and OR gates connected together to perform a computer operation.
